description: Take a screenshot of any webpage. Returns a base64-encoded image.

clip_x.description: Clip region X offset in pixels

clip_y.description: Clip region Y offset in pixels

disable_javascript.description: Disable JavaScript execution on the page. Useful for security research, capturing static HTML, or avoiding JS-driven redirects.

evaluate.description: JavaScript code to execute on the page before capture (max 10KB). Runs in the browser context via page.evaluate(). Use to dismiss modals, click buttons, or set UI state.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to send with the request (e.g., {"Authorization": "Bearer token"})

hide_banners.description: Dismiss cookie banners, consent popups, and overlays before capture

ignore_https_errors.description: Ignore HTTPS/TLS certificate errors (useful for dev/staging environments with self-signed certs)

latitude.description: Geolocation latitude (-90 to 90). Must be used with longitude.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale tag for the browser context (e.g., "en-US", "de-DE", "ja-JP")

longitude.description: Geolocation longitude (-180 to 180). Must be used with latitude.

resize_height.description: Resize output image to this height (maintains aspect ratio)

resize_width.description: Resize output image to this width (maintains aspect ratio)

selector.description: CSS selector to capture specific element

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the browser context (e.g., "America/New_York", "Europe/Berlin", "Asia/Tokyo")

wait_until.description: Page load strategy: "commit" (fastest, response received), "domcontentloaded" (default, DOM ready), "load" (all resources loaded), "networkidle" (no network activity for 500ms — best for SPAs and lazy-loaded content)

name: take_screenshot
